process: Chemical recovery (Sect. 3.3)
value: Recovery boiler: concentrated black liquor (6,000-7,000 Btu/lb) burned to raise steam for process heat and power while the inorganic chemicals are reduced to a molten smelt.

process: Combined heat and power (Ch.8)
value: Gas-turbine combined cycle CHP: turbine exhaust raises steam in a heat recovery steam generator (or preheats combustion air or feed water), and the steam drives a steam turbine for additional power.

process: Combined heat and power (Ch.8)

process: Combined heat and power (Ch.8)

process: Combined heat and power (Ch.8)
note: Boiler and steam turbine systems 90%-95% availability. reprinted from Oland (2004).
